author: Swinhoe, 1871

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(주로 3월 하순~5월 초 서해 섬에서 기록되며, 1월 서울 기록도 있다).

summary: 국내에서는 주로 봄철(3월 하순~5월 초)에 소청도·어청도·흑산도 같은 서해 섬과 동해안 하천에서 해마다 몇 차례 기록되는 드문 길잃은새이다. 바이칼호 둘레의 고지대와 몽골, 중국 내몽골에서 번식한다.

points.en: white face without a dark eye-stripe
black chin, throat and upper breast (breeding plumage)
broad white panel on the wing coverts

sexes.male: 이마의 흰색이 정수리 앞까지 넓고 깨끗하며, 여름깃에서 가슴의 검은 무늬가 크고 둥글다.
sexes.female: 이마의 흰 부분이 좁고 덜 깨끗하며, 가슴의 검은 무늬가 작고 흰 얼룩이 섞인다. 날개의 흰 무늬도 수컷보다 덜 깨끗하다.

young: 머리꼭대기와 등이 올리브빛이 도는 회색이고 흰 눈썹선이 있으며, 멱은 누르스름한 흰색이고 가슴에 흐릿한 말굽 모양 검은 띠가 있다. 날개에는 큰 흰 무늬 대신 흰 날개띠 두 줄이 보인다.

similar.how: 검은턱할미새는 눈앞에서 귀깃까지 검은 눈선이 있으나, 시베리아알락할미새는 눈선이 없어 얼굴이 온통 희다.

art.subject: White Wagtail of the race baicalensis (Motacilla alba baicalensis, Baikal Wagtail), adult male in breeding plumage, a rare spring migrant on a Korean riverbank in March–April: forehead, face and ear-coverts white with no dark eye-stripe; crown and nape black; mantle, back and rump plain grey; chin, throat and upper breast black, forming a bib separated from the black nape by the white sides of the neck; belly and undertail white, flanks washed grey; wing coverts largely white, forming a broad white panel on the closed wing; flight feathers blackish edged white; long black tail with white outer feathers. Thin black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: walking on a pebbly riverbank pumping its tail, side view
art.scene: pebbly river shoal in Korea in early spring (March–April) with dry reeds and bare willows, clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding (spring), side view walking on a gravel bank: white face with no eye-stripe, black crown and nape, plain grey back, black chin, throat and upper breast bib separated from the nape by white neck sides, white belly, broad white wing panel, long black tail with white edges, black legs

adult non-breeding (autumn and winter), side view standing: white face and throat without an eye-stripe, black crown, grey back, a black crescent band across the upper breast, white underparts, white wing panel, black legs
art.build: Slim, long-tailed wagtail, longer than a sparrow and the same size as the White Wagtails common in Korea; horizontal stance, walks briskly and pumps its long tail up and down. Bill black, thin and straight, shorter than the head. Legs black, fairly long and slender. The long, square-ended tail projects far beyond the wingtips. Flight deeply undulating, showing much white in the wing and white tail sides.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint a black line through the eye; a white face with a black eye-stripe marks East Siberian Wagtail (Motacilla alba ocularis).
Do not paint a black back or a white throat above a separate black breast patch on the breeding male; those mark Amur Wagtail (Motacilla alba leucopsis), the race that breeds in Korea.
Do not join the black throat to the black nape so that black encloses the white face; that is Masked Wagtail (Motacilla alba personata).
Do not paint any yellow in the plumage or pale legs.
